author: Radiant Tuition Centre Nayagaun
review_text: I am disappointed with my experience using eSewa. While paying for form submission, Rs. 5.65 was deducted as a service charge without clear prior notice. This lack of transparency is unacceptable for a financial platform. After a few transactions in one day, I also faced unexplained restrictions. This creates confusion and disrupts important payments. The issue is not the fee but trust. Hidden charges and unclear limits make the platform unreliable. Users deserve full clarity before confirming
